answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. I shall take my walk to Lodhi Gardens now. Ramesh, please keep the gate closed behind me.
answer.thought: Shri Hegde's refusal to move is a stubborn particularity that defies the universal order of the state, but I cannot force a man to be free. The air is hazy, and the light is soft; I shall go to the tombs to watch how the spirit of the land manifests in stone, while the bureaucracy waits.
